methods.what: Discriminant of the quadratic form in β, δ rewritten via minors
Introduction of λ as root of a reciprocal quadratic
Shift of variables β+x, δ+y to remove linear terms and solving for x, y
Substitution ζ, ζ' reducing the equation to a quadratic in ζ, ζ'
Completed product form of the reduced equation
